description: Land Aquisition - Sooriyakanda, Kolonna D/S Division, Rathnapura District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains a ministerial order authorizing immediate possession of specific land lots, with detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their locations, boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land matters without involving government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
